content: U mɑɑ yɑ̃ku yeru kuɑ kɑ sii ɡɑndu. Ten dɛ̃ɛbu bu sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɔm soonu yɛndu. Mɑ ten yɑsum mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡɔm soonu yɛndu. Mɑ ten ɡunum mu sɑ̃ɑ ɡɔm soonu wɔkuru.
Boo sii ɡɑnduɡuu
U boo sii ɡɑnduɡuu kuɑ. Gen nɔɔn yɑsum mu sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɔm soonu wɔkuru. Gen ɡunum mɑɑ ɡɔm soonu nɔɔbu. Mɑ ɡen kɛkɛrɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡɔm soonu tɛnɑ. Gɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ bwɛɛrɛkɛ mɑm mɑm.
Bɑ ɡen nɔɔ bɔkɑn temɔ kɛtɛbɑn weenɑsii kuɑ bɑ kɑ sikerenɑ. Gɔm soo teerun bɑɑ sɔɔ, kɛtɛ wɔkurɑ bɑ kuɑ. Bɑ kɛtɛn weenɑsii yi kuɑwɑ sĩɑ yiru. Mɑ ye kpuro yɑ sɑ̃ɑ sii bɔri tiɑ kɑ boo sii ɡɑnduɡuu ɡe.

Bɑ boo ɡe sɔndiwɑ kɛtɛn weenɑsii wɔkurɑ yirun wɔllɔ. Yen itɑ yɑ wuswɑɑ kisi sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ, itɑ mɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ, itɑ yeni mɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ, itɑ ye yɑ mɑɑ tie, sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ. Mɑ boo ɡe, ɡɑ sɔndi kɛtɛn weenɑsii yin wɔllɔ. Mɑ kɛtɛ ben biru ɡɑ wurɑ sɔɔwɔ.
Boo ɡen sinum mu kɑ nɔm tɑrɑru nɛ. Mɑ bɑ ɡen nɔɔ bɔkɑ kuɑ nɡe nɔrɑɡiɑ. Mɑ ɡɑ mɑɑ nɔɔ dɛriɑre nɡe biibii. Gɑ koo kpĩ ɡu nim mwɑ ditiri nɔrɔbun subɑ wunɑɑ teeru (120.000).

U wekenu wɔkuru kuɑ mɑ u nin nɔɔbu yi sɑ̃ɑ yee ten nɔm ɡeuɔ. Nɔɔbu yeni mɑɑ ten nɔm dwɑrɔ bu wɑ bu kɑ tii sɑ̃rɑsiɑ, kpɑ bu mɑɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku yɑɑ kpɑkiɑ bɑ̀ n yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu mɔ̀. Boo sii ɡɑnduɡuu ɡen nimɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ rɑ kɑ ben nɔmɑ kɑ nɑɑsu kpɑkie.
Dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ sisu
U mɑɑ dɑbu wurɑɡinu kuɑ wɑsi wɔkuru. U nu kuɑwɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ nin woodɑ yi. Mɑ u nin nɔɔbu yi sɑ̃ɑ yee ten nɔm ɡeuɔ. Nɔɔbu yeni mɑɑ nɔm dwɑrɔ.
U tɑbulu wɔkuru kuɑ u yi sɑ̃ɑ yeru mi. U nɔɔbu yi nɔm dwɑrɔ, mɑ u mɑɑ nɔɔbu yi nɔm ɡeuɔ. Mɑ u mɑɑ ɡbɛ̃ɛ wurɑɡinu kuɑ wunɔbu (100) nì sɔɔ bɑ ko n dɑ yɑ̃ku yɑɑ yɛm doke bu kɑ yɛ̃kɑ.
U yɑɑrɑ ɡɑɑ kuɑ yɑ̃ku kowobun sɔ̃. Yen biru, u mɑɑ yɑɑrɑ bɑkɑ ɡɑɑ kuɑ kɑ yen ɡɑmbobɑ. Mɑ u ɡɑmbo be sii ɡɑndu pote.
U boo sii ɡɑnduɡuu ɡe yiwɑ yɑɑrɑ yen nɔm ɡeuɔ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerun nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ.
Hurɑmu u torom ɡurɑtii kuɑ kɑ kɑɑtonu kɑ ɡbɛ̃ɑ yè sɔɔ bɑ ko n dɑ yɑ̃ku yɑɑ yɛm doke bu kɑ yɛ̃kɑ. Nɡe mɛyɑ u kɑ sɔmbu te kuɑ u kpɑ te sinɑ boko Sɑlomɔɔ u nùn yiire u ko Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yee ten sɔ̃.
Wee ye u mɑɑ kuɑ. Yerɑ ɡbere yiru kɑ furɔsu yiru si bɑ koo doke ɡbere ben wɔllɔ kɑ kɔkɔsɔ bwesenu yiru ye bɑ koo sɔndi furɔ sin wɔllɔ.
U mɑɑ dɑ̃ɑ mɑrum weenɑsim kuɑ nɛɛru (400) kɔkɔsɔ yiru yen sɔ̃. Kɔkɔsɔ yiru yen bɑɑyere sɔɔ, dɑ̃ɑ mɑrum weenɑsim mɛn sĩɑ yiru yiruwɑ u kuɑ u kɑ sɔndi furɔ sin wɔllɔ.
U wekenu kuɑ wɔkuru kɑ nin sɔwɑritii wɔkuru.
U boo sii ɡɑnduɡuu kuɑ, kɑ kɛtɛn weenɑsii wɔkurɑ yiru yi yi boo ɡe sɔɔwɑ.
U mɑɑ torom ɡurɑtii kuɑ, kɑ kɑɑtonu, kɑ kɑɑto donnuɡinu. Dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni sinɑ boko Sɑlomɔɔ u derɑ Hurɑmɑbi u kuɑ mi, u nu kuɑwɑ kɑ sii ɡɑn te bɑ wɔriɑsiɑ.
U derɑ bɑ yɑ̃ɑ ni kpuro kuɑ kɑ sii ɡɑndu Yuudɛnin wɔwɑɔ mi sɔndɑ wɑ̃ɑ Sukɔtu kɑ Seredɑn bɑɑ sɔɔ.
Sɑlomɔɔ u derɑ bɑ dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni kuɑ nu dɑbi sere bɑ ǹ mɑɑ sii ɡɑn ten bunum yĩirɑ.
Sɑlomɔɔ u mɑɑ derɑ bɑ dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni nu tie kuɑ. Niyɑ yɑ̃ku yee wurɑɡii te, kɑ tɑbulu yè sɔɔ bɑ rɑ pɛ̃ɛ sɔndi,
kɑ dɑbunu kɑ nin fitilɑnu ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ wurɑ ɡeɑ. Bɑ koo nu sɔ̃rɑwɑ nɡe mɛ sɑ̃ɑ yerun woodɑ yɑ ɡeruɑ.
U mɑɑ biibiin weenɑsii kuɑ kɑ fitilɑnu kɑ nin bɑkusu. U ye kpuro kuɑwɑ kɑ wurɑ ɡeɑ.
U mɑɑ wobɑ kuɑ, kɑ nɔri, kɑ ɡbɛ̃ɑ, kɑ dɔ̃ɔ ɡurɑtii. Bɑ ye kpuro kuɑwɑ kɑ wurɑ ɡeɑ. U mɑɑ dii te tɑ dɛɛre ɡem ɡem ɡɑmbobɑ kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten tiin kɔnnɔn ɡɑmbobɑ kuɑ kɑ wurɑ.
